nodes.description: External view function selectWinner(address[] calldata users, uint256 salt) that derives a pseudorandom winner index from block properties and returns users[winnerIndex].
Calldata array of candidate addresses supplied by the caller; its length drives the winner index bound.
Caller-supplied uint256 salt mixed into the keccak256 hash used for winner selection.
Local variable size = users.length, used as the modulus denominator for the winner index.
Local bytes32 hash = keccak256 over address(this), block values, size and salt; the entropy source for the draw.
Local uint256 winnerIndex = uint256(hash) % size, used to index into the users array.
block.timestamp, a miner/validator-influenceable value included in the randomness hash, making the draw predictable and manipulable.
Modulo operation uint256(hash) % size with no zero-length guard; reverts or panics when users is empty and produces miner-influenceable randomness.

edges.reason: selectWinner reads the calldata users array argument.
selectWinner reads the calldata salt argument.
users.length is assigned to the local size variable.
Caller-controlled salt is encoded into the hash used for winner selection.
size is encoded into the hash input, coupling array length to the entropy.
size is used as the modulus denominator without a zero-length check, allowing division-by-zero revert/panic on an empty users array.
The hash value is converted to uint256 and used as the numerator of the modulo operation.
The modulo result is assigned to winnerIndex, propagating the unsafe arithmetic result.
block.timestamp is mixed into the hash, so a miner/validator can bias the random draw by choosing the timestamp (timestamp dependency).
Execution of selectWinner unconditionally reaches the modulo that bounds the winner index.
winnerIndex is used to index users and the resulting address is returned from the function.
The function's outcome depends on the miner-influenceable block.timestamp, creating a timestamp-dependency weakness in the winner selection.

normalization_plan.reason: The users parameter has no independent behavior; it is only consumed by selectWinner and should be folded into the function node.
The salt parameter is only used inside selectWinner's hash computation, so it is abstracted into the function node.
size exists solely as the denominator of the unsafe modulo operation and is merged into that unsafe_operation node.
hash is only used as the numerator feeding the unsafe modulo operation and is absorbed by that unsafe_operation node.
winnerIndex is the direct product of the unsafe modulo operation and is folded into that unsafe_operation node.
